rules.text: Any bank-detail change must be confirmed by calling the phone on file. Email or SMS confirmation is not enough.
Invoices above 2x the vendor's typical amount need a purchase order before payment.
Never pay by gift card. Gift cards are not a valid supplier or payroll method.
A request to keep a payment secret, skip audit, or avoid calling someone back is a stop signal.
Voice payment requests must be returned on the number in the employee directory. Do not follow 'don't call back' instructions.
Pay only to domains and reply-to addresses that match the vendor record in ERP. Lookalike spellings are treated as hostile until proven otherwise.
